Headquartered in Shanghai with a global footprint across the Asia Pacific region and beyond, Antengene's marketed product XPOVIO (selinexor) and a pipeline of oncology assets such as the Claudin 18.2 antibody-drug conjugate ATG-022 and the CD73 inhibitor ATG-037 target unmet needs in cancer care. Antengene operates in the life sciences sector and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and captured in the API Evangelist network for company intelligence and enrichment.

providers.name: BioNTech
providers.description: BioNTech is a Mainz-based biotechnology company that pioneered the use of messenger RNA (mRNA) technology in human therapeutics. Best known for co-developing Comirnaty, the COVID-19 mRNA vaccine with Pfizer, BioNTech is building a broad oncology pipeline across mRNA cancer immunotherapies, next-generation immunomodulators such as the bispecific antibody BNT327, and targeted therapies, as well as continuing infectious disease vaccine development. BioNTech does not currently expose a public developer API; this index captures the company's products, pipeline, clinical trials, and corporate resources as an API Evangelist profile.

providers.name: Bitterroot Bio
providers.description: Bitterroot Bio is a privately held, clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Palo Alto, California, pioneering the emerging field of cardio-immunology — the interplay between the immune system and cardiovascular disease. Its lead program, BRB-002, is a novel investigational immunomodulating protein therapy that targets CD47 to treat atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) by acting on atherosclerotic plaque through the immunomodulation of macrophages, an approach distinct from current standards of care. Founded in 2021, the company is advancing BRB-002 through its MATADOR Phase 2a proof-of-concept study. Bitterroot Bio is a therapeutics developer and publishes no public developer API or programmatic surface; this profile captures its public web identity within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cartography Biosciences
providers.description: Cartography Biosciences is a South San Francisco biotechnology company developing precision cancer immunotherapies designed around tumor-selective antigens. Using single-cell genomics, proteomics, and novel binder-discovery methods, the company profiles antigen expression across thousands of patient samples and millions of cells to build a comprehensive antigen atlas, classifying cancers by antigen expression rather than histology or genetic mutation. Its goal is to direct immunotherapies toward the safest and most effective targets. Backed by a16z, Cartography was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a corporate and careers website but no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Cellares
providers.description: Cellares is an Integrated Development and Manufacturing Organization (IDMO) for cell therapies, operating a global network of automated "Smart Factories." Its FDA-recognized Cell Shuttle platform delivers high-throughput, end-to-end, cGMP industrial-scale cell therapy manufacturing, and its Cell Q platform automates quality-control testing of cell therapy products. Smart Factories operate in South San Francisco (CA), Bridgewater (NJ), Leiden (Netherlands), and Kashiwa (Japan). Cellares was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and profiled in the API Evangelist network; as a cell therapy manufacturing organization it publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Creyon Bio
providers.description: Creyon Bio (branded Creyon) is a San Diego drug-development company operating an AI-powered nucleic acid engineering platform, NucleIQ, that designs oligonucleotide and RNA therapies with tissue- and cell-specific delivery. Creyon uses aptamer-based delivery, lipid nanoparticles, and transferrin-receptor aptamers to cross the blood-brain barrier, targeting immunology, central nervous system (CNS), and neuromuscular indications including late-onset Pompe disease. The company is a venture-backed portfolio company of DCVC and currently advances three wholly-owned programs. This profile is a company/identity record in the API Evangelist network; Creyon publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Dyno
providers.description: Dyno Therapeutics is an AI and biotechnology company building high-performance gene delivery technologies to unlock the potential of next-generation genetic medicine. Using its CapsidMap platform, which combines machine learning with high-throughput in vivo measurement, Dyno designs novel adeno-associated virus (AAV) capsids with improved tissue targeting, immune evasion, manufacturability, and payload capacity. The company partners with leading gene therapy developers rather than exposing a public developer API; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an a16z Bio+Health portfolio company. Founded on research from George Church's lab at Harvard, Dyno is headquartered in Watertown, Massachusetts.

providers.name: Inovia Bio
providers.description: Inovia Bio is a TechBio company delivering drug development strategy and evidence generation for biotech and pharmaceutical organizations, aiming to combine big-pharma impact with biotech speed. It pairs purpose-built platforms with advisory services to produce regulatory-grade evidence, covering clinical development planning and trial design, therapeutic product profiles (TPP), development, regulatory and commercial strategy, Integrated Evidence Plans (IEP/IEGP), Real World Evidence (RWE) for regulatory submissions, and clinical program rescue. Its Study Designer platform (diagity.inovia.bio) supports study design workflows. Inovia Bio is a Seedcamp portfolio company; no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation are published at this time.

providers.name: Karius
providers.description: Karius is an infectious disease diagnostics company that applies clinical metagenomics and machine learning to microbial cell-free DNA (mcfDNA) circulating in the bloodstream, detecting pathogens that conventional culture-based testing misses. Its CLIA-certified and CAP-accredited laboratory runs the Karius Spectrum blood test, which screens a single blood draw for more than 1,000 bacteria, fungi, DNA viruses, and parasites, and the Karius Focus BAL test, which detects more than 500 pathogens in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid for lung infections. Results are returned to clinicians managing complex, immunocompromised, and difficult-to-diagnose patients.

providers.name: Parabilis Medicines
providers.description: Parabilis Medicines (formerly FogPharma) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing a new class of ultra-tunable alpha-helical peptide therapeutics called Helicons to reach intracellular protein targets long considered undruggable. Its AI- and physics-based discovery platform underpins a pipeline led by zolucatetide, a candidate targeting the beta-catenin / TCF interaction in the Wnt signaling pathway across multiple cancers. Backed by more than $500M from leading life sciences investors and public since its June 2026 IPO (Nasdaq: PBLS), the company was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and GV. It publishes a public marketing and investor web presence and a science/data tech blog, but exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Protagonist Therapeutics
providers.description: Protagonist Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Newark, California and founded in 2006. It discovers and develops peptide-based new chemical entities using a proprietary peptide discovery and engineering platform, targeting rare and prevalent diseases with significant unmet medical need. Lead programs include rusfertide, a hepcidin mimetic in Phase 3 for polycythemia vera, and icotrokinra (PN-235), an oral IL-23 receptor antagonist partnered with Johnson & Johnson. The company is publicly traded (Nasdaq: PTGX) following its 2016 IPO. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or agent surface.

providers.name: Qlaris Bio
providers.description: Qlaris Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing first-in-class therapies for ophthalmic diseases, with a mission to preserve vision and prevent blindness. Its lead candidate, QLS-111, uses a novel mechanism of action to lower intraocular pressure by targeting the distal outflow pathway, and is being evaluated for primary open-angle glaucoma, ocular hypertension, and elevated IOP associated with conditions such as Sturge-Weber Syndrome. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a clinical-stage drug developer, Qlaris Bio publishes a corporate website but no public developer, API, or product integration surface.

providers.name: Roivant
providers.description: Roivant Sciences Ltd. (Nasdaq: ROIV) is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical holding company that accelerates the development and commercialization of medicines through its distinctive "Vant" model, a network of nimble, focused subsidiary companies such as Immunovant, Priovant, and Pulmovant. Founded in 2014, Roivant advances a pipeline spanning immunology, dermatology, and other therapeutic areas, and has delivered multiple FDA approvals and Phase 3 trial successes. Roivant is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; it operates a corporate and investor web presence but publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Spero Therapeutics
providers.description: Spero Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company advancing innovative medicines for immune-mediated and infectious diseases. Its pipeline includes SP001, a third-generation anti-CD40L antibody targeting IgG4-related disease, alongside earlier programs in antibacterial and rare-disease therapeutics. Spero was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network. As a life-sciences drug developer, Spero publishes a corporate and investor-relations web presence but no public developer API, developer portal, or technical integration surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Switch Therapeutics
providers.description: Switch Therapeutics is a precision neuroscience biotechnology company founded in 2020 and based in San Francisco, California, developing biomarker-gated genetic medicines for central nervous system (CNS) diseases with high unmet need. Its Conditionally Activated siRNA (CASi) platform combines properties of single- and double-stranded RNAs in one molecule to enable efficient self-delivery, potent and durable gene knockdown, and cell-type/cell-state selectivity. Its lead development candidate is CASi-APOE, a liver-sparing APOE RNAi therapy. The company is backed by CRV and Insight Partners and is a therapeutics developer with no public developer API, SDK, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Zencore Biologics
providers.description: Zencore Biologics (zgbiotech.com) is a one-stop biologics CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organization) technology service platform serving pharmaceutical clients globally. Its services span large-molecule biologics development and production, antibody-drug conjugates (ADC), cell culture media, analytical and quality testing, and regulatory registration support. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm qiming; this profile is a corporate/biotech entity with no public developer API surface (no OpenAPI, well-known, or event/webhook interfaces were found).

providers.name: ElevateBio
providers.description: ElevateBio is an advanced therapies technology company and contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) for cell and gene therapies, headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. Through its BaseCamp cGMP manufacturing and process-development business and its centers of excellence, ElevateBio provides end-to-end capabilities spanning gene editing, viral vectors (AAV and lentivirus), mRNA and RNA therapeutics, induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), analytical and process development, and regulatory CMC support, helping partners advance genetic medicines from concept through commercialization. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the SoftBank Vision Fund and profiled in the API Evangelist network, ElevateBio operates as a science- and manufacturing-driven organization rather than a public API provider; this profile captures its identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Hongene Biotech
providers.description: Hongene Biotech Corporation is a nucleic acid contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) founded in 1998, with nearly 30 years of RNA-focused expertise. It offers vertically integrated services spanning oligonucleotide API manufacturing (from preclinical to commercial, GMP up to tonne scale), mRNA CDMO services (raw materials through enzymes and lipids to GMP manufacture and fill-finish), custom chemical synthesis of nucleic acid building blocks, and chemoenzymatic ligation for siRNA and sgRNA. Hongene supplies premium nucleic acid raw materials worldwide and runs an online store for direct-purchase reagents. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and enriched from Hongene public web surfaces; the company publishes no developer API.

providers.name: Verana Health
providers.description: Verana Health is a healthcare real-world data (RWD) and analytics company that transforms de-identified electronic health records from more than 90 million patients across 50+ EHR systems into curated, disease-specific datasets for life sciences and clinical research. Its VeraQ population health data engine harmonizes, tokenizes, and links structured and unstructured EHR data, claims, and medical images using clinician-directed curation, natural language processing, and machine learning, delivering Qdata modules across ophthalmology, urology, and neurology. Verana partners with medical specialty societies (including the AAO IRIS Registry) to power trial design, site and patient identification, real-world evidence studies, and quality-measure reporting. The company is HIPAA-compliant and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV. No public developer API or developer portal is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Adagio Therapeutics
providers.description: Adagio Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2020 to discover, develop, and commercialize antibody-based therapies for serious infectious diseases, with an initial focus on SARS-CoV-2 and other respiratory viruses. Its lead programs centered on monoclonal antibody candidates engineered for high potency and broad, evolution-resistant neutralization. The company was renamed Invivyd, Inc. in 2023 (Nasdaq: IVVD) and now advances antibody medicines such as PEMGARDA and the VYD2311 candidate. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network. As a life-sciences therapeutics company it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures corporate identity and policy links only.

providers.name: Aera Therapeutics
providers.description: Aera Therapeutics is a genetic-medicines biotechnology company founded by a team of scientists, investors, and company builders to unlock the potential of genetic medicines through next-generation delivery technologies and precision payloads. Aera develops multiple proprietary delivery platforms — including Targeted Lipid Nanoparticles (tLNPs) and protein-nanoparticle systems — to broaden the application of genetic medicines across many disease areas, advancing a broad preclinical pipeline toward the clinic. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network. Aera is a therapeutics company and publishes no public developer API, portal, or documentation surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and domain-security posture. Sector: life-sciences.

providers.name: Arvinas
providers.description: Arvinas is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company (NASDAQ: ARVN) headquartered in New Haven, Connecticut, developing targeted protein degradation therapeutics using its proprietary PROTAC (proteolysis targeting chimera) Discovery Engine. PROTAC molecules are heterobifunctional protein degraders that harness the body's natural protein-disposal system to eliminate disease-causing proteins rather than merely inhibiting them, with a therapeutic focus on oncology and neurology. Arvinas developed the first FDA-approved PROTAC protein degrader, VEPPANU (vepdegestrant). The company was founded on research from Yale University and maintains research partnerships across the industry. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; Arvinas is a life-sciences company and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Auron Therapeutics
providers.description: Auron Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Newton, Massachusetts, developing therapies that target cell-state plasticity to address the underlying causes of disease across oncology and inflammatory disease indications. The company built the AURIGIN platform, which integrates multi-omic profiling and computational biology to map how cells change states and identify those states that can be therapeutically targeted. Auron was founded by Dr. Katharine Yen with co-founders Dr. Ross Levine, Dr. Eytan Stein, and Dr. Matthew Vander Heiden, a team drawing on experience from Agios Pharmaceuticals and its FDA-approved IDH inhibitor programs. It is backed by investors including Apollo, Arkin Bio, Casdin Capital, and DCVC Bio. As a therapeutics company Auron publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal; this profile captures its corporate and legal web presence only.

providers.name: Chemify
providers.description: Chemify is a Glasgow-based programmable-chemistry company, spun out of the University of Glasgow in 2022 by chemist Lee Cronin, that digitizes the creation of molecules through what it calls "Chemputation." The platform fuses AI/ML-driven molecular design, a universal chemical programming language, and robotic synthesis so pharmaceutical, biotech, and industrial partners can move from a novel concept to a makeable compound end to end. In 2025 Chemify opened its first Chemifarm, a fully automated chemistry facility in Glasgow's Maryhill district that pairs its molecular-design engine with industrial-scale robotic synthesis, and closed a $50M Series B co-led by Wing Venture Capital and Insight Partners, with backing from DCVC. Chemify does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; engagement runs through its partner program.

providers.name: Chemify Limited
providers.description: Chemify Limited is a chemistry-automation company founded in 2022 by Professor Lee Cronin, building on two decades of research at the University of Glasgow and headquartered in Glasgow, Scotland. Chemify develops "Chemputation" — programmable chemistry — fusing chemistry, robotics, computation, machine learning, and its own universal chemical programming language (chi-DL / XDL) to digitize the discovery, design, and synthesis of molecules on hardware-agnostic robotic chemistry platforms. Its ASSEMBLER stack converts optimized reaction information into fully defined chemical code that automated synthesis machines can execute. The company is backed by Insight Partners and DCVC. Chemify does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record with domain-security posture and public site properties.

providers.name: Connect Biopharma
providers.description: Connect Biopharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, dedicated to transforming care for patients with inflammatory diseases such as asthma and COPD. Its lead drug candidate, rademikibart (CBP-201), is an antibody targeting IL-4Ra in Phase 2 clinical development for acute asthma and COPD exacerbations. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network, the company operates in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sector and publishes no public developer portal, API, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Dren Bio
providers.description: Dren Bio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Foster City, California, focused on the discovery and development of novel antibody therapeutics that selectively deplete pathogenic cells and other disease-causing agents. Its proprietary Targeted Myeloid Engager and Phagocytosis Platform is a multispecific, antibody-based technology designed to induce potent depletion of disease-causing agents by engaging a novel phagocytic receptor selectively expressed on myeloid cells. The pipeline spans two first-in-class clinical-stage programs (including DR-01 and DR-0202) plus multiple preclinical and discovery-stage programs across oncology, autoimmune disease, immunology, and neurology. Dren Bio has established strategic collaborations with Pfizer and Sanofi, the latter of which acquired its DR-0201 (SAR448501) bispecific myeloid cell engager program. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public API or developer surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Elo Life
providers.description: Elo Life Systems is a next-generation food and agriculture company based in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, using molecular farming and gene-editing to turn high-yield crops into biofactories for natural food ingredients. Its lead product is a low-calorie, high-potency natural sweetener inspired by monk fruit that is designed to taste like sugar while replacing both sugar and artificial sweeteners at a lower cost. Elo also partners with Dole to develop a fungus-resistant (TR4/Fusarium wilt) Cavendish banana. Backed by DCVC Bio and Novo Holdings, the company raised an oversubscribed $20.5M Series A2 to scale its molecular-farming platform. Elo Life is a food-tech / agricultural-biotech company and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Engrail
providers.description: Engrail Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2019 and focused on precision neuroscience. The company develops innovative, precision-targeted small-molecule therapeutics aimed at the molecular mechanisms and neural circuits underlying nervous system disorders, combining internal discovery with strategic partnerships. Its pipeline includes candidates ENX-102, ENX-104, ENX-203, and ENX-205 for patients with devastating and life-limiting neurological conditions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public developer/API surface.

providers.name: Enlaza Therapeutics
providers.description: Enlaza Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in La Jolla, California developing first-in-class covalent protein biologics for cancer and other serious diseases. Its proprietary War-Lock technology uses engineered unnatural amino acids to enable protein drugs — including antibody-drug conjugates and T-cell engagers — to bind their disease targets irreversibly, aiming for sustained target occupancy and a prolonged biologic effect with minimal systemic exposure across oncology and immuno-oncology applications. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a corporate website but no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Gourmey
providers.description: Gourmey is a Paris-based cultivated meat company producing sustainable, cell-cultured meat delights — starting with cultivated foie gras — for an uncompromising and conscious generation. Founded in France and backed by Partech and Point Nine, Gourmey grows real meat directly from animal cells without raising or slaughtering animals, aiming for a lower environmental footprint across the food and agritech sectors. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company profile; Gourmey operates a consumer and corporate website but does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: ltztherapeutics
providers.description: LTZ Therapeutics is a clinical-stage immunotherapy biotechnology company developing novel myeloid engager therapeutics for cancer treatment. Its platform focuses on the direct engagement of myeloid cells with target cells to boost anti-tumor immunity, with lead candidate LTZ-232 receiving FDA IND clearance in July 2026 for advanced metastatic colorectal cancer and other solid tumors. The company operates from Redwood City, USA and Shenzhen, China. It is a portfolio company of Qiming and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment; it publishes no developer API surface.

providers.name: Ollin Bio
providers.description: Ollin Bio is a privately held biotechnology company developing novel therapeutics, organizing its work around defined therapeutic areas and a product pipeline of drug candidates in development. Backed by a16z, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead. As a research-stage therapeutics company, Ollin Bio publishes a marketing and corporate website but does not expose a public developer program, API, documentation, or SDKs at this time. This profile records the company's public identity and web properties; it will be re-enriched if a public API surface ever appears.

providers.name: Outpace Bio
providers.description: Outpace Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company applying AI-powered protein design to cell therapy, with the mission of curing solid tumors. The company engineers novel proteins that reprogram immune cells to overcome the limitations of current cancer immunotherapies, built on a set of proprietary platform technologies (OUTSPACER, OUTSMART, OUTLAST, OUTSAFE) and logic-gated cell targeting. Outpace Bio is a private, research-driven organization backed by Playground Global; it operates no public developer API, SDK, or third-party technical platform, so this API Evangelist profile captures company identity, web properties, and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Pelage Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Pelage Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing regenerative medicines for hair loss based on hair follicle stem cell biology discovered by UCLA researchers. Its lead candidate, PP405, is a topically-applied small molecule that reactivates dormant hair follicle stem cells via a metabolic switch to stimulate regrowth, targeting androgenetic alopecia, drug-induced alopecia, and telogen effluvium; it is non-hormonal, non-invasive, and in Phase 2 clinical trials. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). It publishes a corporate site and a clinical-trials site but no public developer, API, or technical surface.

providers.name: Prime Medicine
providers.description: Prime Medicine is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a new class of differentiated one-time curative genetic therapies built on Prime Editing, a versatile, precise, and efficient gene editing technology that can search and replace disease-causing genetic sequences at their precise location in the genome without causing double-strand DNA breaks. The company is advancing a pipeline of programs across a broad range of diseases and, per its public materials, believes Prime Editing could theoretically correct approximately 90% of known disease-causing genetic mutations. It is publicly traded and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). This is a corporate/life-sciences profile: the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Revalia Bio
providers.description: Revalia Bio transforms donated, non-transplantable human organs and tissues into high-fidelity biological datasets, using AI to accelerate drug and device development. The company has built "The Human Data Stack" — infrastructure spanning data generation, ingestion, integration, interpretation, and delivery of decision-ready clinical insights for pharma, biotech, healthcare, and regulatory customers. Applications include safety signal detection, dose and target selection, patient selection, and mechanism-of-action studies. Founded by Greg Tietjen (CEO) and Jenna DiRito (COO), it generated first revenue in 2023 and raised seed funding in 2024. Backed by Sierra Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Revalia Bio publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or technical surface — it is a B2B research-services company, not a developer platform.

providers.name: Structure Therapeutics
providers.description: Structure Therapeutics (NASDAQ: GPCR) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in South San Francisco, California, developing novel oral small-molecule medicines for chronic diseases with significant unmet medical need. The company applies a structure-based drug discovery platform focused on G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) to design once-daily oral therapies, with lead programs centered on oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonists for obesity and metabolic disease. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Structure Therapeutics maintains a corporate and investor web presence, but no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: UPSIDE Foods
providers.description: UPSIDE Foods is an Emeryville, California-based cultivated meat company (The UPSIDE Group Inc.) that grows real meat directly from animal cells - no farm, no slaughter. Its flagship product is UPSIDE Chicken, cultivated chicken cleared for sale in the United States following FDA review, offered through foodservice partners, with public tours of its EPIC (Engineering, Production, and Innovation Center) facility. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio company; enrichment probing found no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, GitHub organization, or event surface.

providers.name: Vera Therapeutics
providers.description: Vera Therapeutics is a clinical- and commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Brisbane, California, developing treatments for serious immunological and inflammatory diseases of the kidney. Its lead program, atacicept (marketed as TRUTAKNA), is a dual BAFF/APRIL inhibitor for IgA nephropathy (IgAN). Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment, Vera Therapeutics publishes a corporate and patient-facing website (veratx.com) but exposes no public developer portal, API, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface. Sector: life-sciences.

providers.name: Vividion Therapeutics
providers.description: Vividion Therapeutics is a San Diego-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company that discovers and develops precision small-molecule medicines for previously undruggable disease targets. Its proprietary chemoproteomics platform pairs covalent chemistry with proteome-wide screening to map druggable pockets across the human proteome, driving a pipeline in oncology and immunology (including VVD-214, a WRN helicase inhibitor for MSI-high cancers). Vividion was acquired by Bayer in 2021 and operates as an independent subsidiary. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund; this profile has been enriched and carries no public developer or API surface (a corporate/scientific website only).

providers.name: Alpha-9 Oncology
providers.description: Alpha-9 Oncology is a clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical company developing targeted radioligand therapies and imaging agents to treat solid and hematologic cancers with high precision. Founded in 2019 and backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, the company engineers each molecule — binder, linker, chelator, and radioisotope — through a bespoke, iterative optimization process, and is advancing a pipeline that includes the A9-3202 imaging agent and the Actinium-225-based therapeutic A9-3408 into clinical trials. Alpha-9 is a therapeutics company with no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; it was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead from Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: Breezebio
providers.description: BreezeBio (formerly GenEdit) is a South San Francisco genetic-medicine company developing precision-delivered nucleic acid therapies for autoimmune disease and oncology. Its proprietary NanoGalaxy platform uses non-lipid, hydrophilic polymer nanoparticles of tunable size, charge, and composition to selectively deliver DNA, RNA, and ribonucleoprotein payloads to specific tissues and cell types beyond the liver — including immune cells and targets in the heart, lung, and central nervous system. The company is advancing an internal therapeutic pipeline led by BRZ-101, which aims to restore immune tolerance in type 1 diabetes, and in February 2026 closed a $60M Series B backed by DCVC Bio, Sequoia Capital, and other investors. BreezeBio is a research-stage biopharmaceutical company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile tracks its corporate and identity surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Dewpoint Therapeutics
providers.description: Dewpoint Therapeutics is a biotechnology company applying the emerging science of biomolecular condensates to drug discovery. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, with an additional research site in Dresden, Germany, Dewpoint has built an AI-powered, end-to-end platform (ERSA, powered by ERSAi) spanning target discovery, condensate-modulating (c-mod) drug discovery, optimization, and development. Its pipeline targets previously undruggable diseases across oncology, neurodegeneration, cardiopulmonary, and virology, with collaborations including Bayer, Novo Nordisk, Evotec, and Chemify. Dewpoint is a General Catalyst portfolio company; it operates internal research platforms and the open CD-CODE condensate knowledge platform (condensates.com), but does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Frontier Medicines
providers.description: Frontier Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering the discovery and development of small-molecule covalent drugs against disease-causing proteins long considered undruggable. Its proprietary Frontier Platform pairs chemoproteomics with artificial intelligence and machine learning and a proprietary Druggability Atlas that maps thousands of novel covalent binding opportunities across the human proteome. Lead precision oncology candidates include FMC-376 (KRAS G12C), FMC-220 (a p53 Y220C reactivator), and FMC-242 (PI3Kalpha-RAS). Founded in 2018 with offices in Boston, Massachusetts and South San Francisco, California, the company is backed by DCVC and other life-science investors. Frontier Medicines was added to the API Evangelist network as a DCVC portfolio company; it publishes no public API or developer surface, so this profile captures company identity only.

providers.name: Obsidian Therapeutics
providers.description: Obsidian Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing engineered cell and gene therapies built on its proprietary cytoDRiVE platform, which uses drug-responsive domains to regulate therapeutic protein function with an FDA-approved small molecule. Its lead program, OBX-115, is in Phase 2 trials for advanced melanoma. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a life-sciences company with no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Rallybio
providers.description: Rallybio Corporation (NASDAQ RLYB) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in New Haven, Connecticut, founded in 2018, developing and commercializing life-transforming therapies for patients with severe and rare diseases. Its pipeline spans maternal-fetal health, complement dysregulation, hematology, and metabolic disorders, led by RLYB116, a differentiated complement component 5 (C5) inhibitor, and RLYB332, a long-acting matriptase-2 (MTP-2) antibody for iron-overload disorders. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a pharmaceutical company it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures corporate identity only.

providers.name: Thyme Care
providers.description: Thyme Care is a value-based oncology care-navigation and support company that partners with health plans, providers, and employers to guide people through a cancer diagnosis and treatment. Its virtual oncology care team and navigators help members access care, coordinate with treating physicians, manage symptoms and side effects, understand costs, and improve outcomes across the cancer journey. Thyme Care delivers this through partner programs (Thyme Care Connect, Thyme Care Signal, Thyme Box, and Enhanced Supportive Care) rather than a public developer platform. As of this enrichment pass, no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or /.well-known API-discovery surface were found for Thyme Care; it is profiled here as a company, not an API provider.

providers.name: TimeTrace Labs
providers.description: TimeTrace Labs is a London-based mathematics and artificial intelligence company building the measurement layer for healthcare, spun out of a decade of research at the University of Oxford and backed by Seedcamp and Fly Ventures. Its quantitative measurement platform separates signal from noise in multimodal physiological time-series (kinematics, EEG, ECG, actigraphy, glucose, voice), powering analytics for drug development, clinical trials, and public health that the company delivers to partners through secure APIs and a compliant analytics dashboard — though it publishes no public developer portal or API documentation yet.

providers.name: Totus Medicines
providers.description: Totus Medicines is a biopharmaceutical company developing precision oral medicines against historically "undruggable" disease targets. The company's OmniDEL discovery platform screens targets in their normal cellular environment to identify potent, selective covalent small molecules, drawing on precedents like penicillin and AZT. Totus is advancing a pipeline focused on oncology and immunology & inflammation (I&I), including TOS-358, a covalent PI3Ka inhibitor, and a first-in-class covalent IRF5 inhibitor in clinical development. Headquartered in Emeryville, California, Totus was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and profiled in the API Evangelist network. As a clinical-stage drug-discovery company, Totus publishes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its corporate identity, web properties, and security posture.

providers.name: Unchained Labs
providers.description: Unchained Labs is a life-science tools company that designs, manufactures, and sells analytical instruments, automation, and consumables for biologics, gene therapy, cell therapy, nanoparticle, exosome, and genomics research. Its product line includes plate-based systems for protein characterization, concentration and quantification (Lunatic and Stunner), protein stability and formulation (Uncle), automated buffer exchange and sample prep (Big Tuna, Little Big Tuna), viscosity measurement, and lipid-nanoparticle synthesis and analysis. The company serves biopharma R&D, process development, and QC labs. Unchained Labs is primarily a hardware, reagent, and lab-software vendor; as of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, REST/GraphQL surface, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and enriched with verified company identity and link properties from its public website.

providers.name: Zag Bio
providers.description: Zag Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing thymus-targeted therapies for autoimmune diseases. The company engineers bifunctional antibodies that deliver self-antigens to antigen-presenting cells in the thymus, harnessing the body's natural process of central immune tolerance so developing immune cells learn to recognize, tolerate, and protect the body's own tissues. Its pipeline includes ZAG-101, a candidate for Type 1 Diabetes. Founded and incubated by Polaris Partners, Zag Bio launched publicly in October 2025 with an $80M Series A. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio company; as a therapeutics developer it publishes no public API or developer platform at this time.

providers.name: Tierra Biosciences
providers.description: Tierra Biosciences is a San Leandro, California synthetic biology company using AI-guided, cell-free protein production to synthesize custom proteins on demand for pharmaceutical, industrial, and agricultural research. Its customer-facing Tierra Protein Platform is a web-based eCommerce ordering portal where researchers enter protein sequences and get custom proteins synthesized, validated, and shipped. The company (rebranding toward Revr Bio) is backed by prosus-ventures and Material Impact. No public developer API, SDK, or programmatic-access surface is currently published; this profile was enriched and confirmed as a web-platform-only provider.

providers.name: Alta Resource Technologies
providers.description: Alta Resource Technologies is a Colorado-based deep-tech company reinventing how critical minerals are sourced. It uses advanced biochemistry — customizable, engineered proteins licensed from Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory and co-developed with researchers at Pennsylvania State University — to selectively separate high-purity rare earth elements and other strategic metals from low-grade ores, mining tailings, and electronic-waste streams such as end-of-life hard disk drives. The protein-based platform binds target elements out of complex, low-concentration solutions with high selectivity while dramatically reducing the environmental footprint of conventional mining and refining, strengthening U.S. and allied critical-mineral supply chains. Alta emerged from stealth in January 2025 and expanded its Series Seed to $10M, backed by DCVC, Voyager Ventures, In-Q-Tel, and Orion Industrial Ventures. As a materials-science and biochemistry company, Alta does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this API Evangelist profile carries its identity and website properties only.

providers.name: Anto Biosciences
providers.description: Anto Biosciences is a frontier biology AI lab making the gut microbiome computable for the first time. It builds foundation models for microbial communities and quality-aware, goal-directed sparsification algorithms that filter noise from microbiome data to predict how the gut microbiome affects drug efficacy, toxicity, and safety across diverse populations (by geography, age, and diet). Applications include population-specific drug response prediction, identifying failure mechanisms at the microbial metabolic-pathway level, and molecule optimization for broader effectiveness. Backed by Y Combinator, the company is early stage and research-focused; it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or a GitHub organization. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead and enriched with verified identity links only (no API artifacts, none published).

providers.name: Benson Hill *
providers.description: Benson Hill (now operating as Confluence Genetics at confluence.ag) is a seed-innovation company that develops high-protein, energy-dense soybean varieties using AI-driven plant science and advanced crop genetics. Its soy solutions serve three markets — animal feed, human food, and renewable fuel — pairing proven genetics with technology and environmental responsibility. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a GV portfolio lead; the company has since rebranded from Benson Hill to Confluence Genetics and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: EnerGaia
providers.description: EnerGaia is a spirulina producer, incorporated in Thailand in April 2009 and now headquartered in Singapore, that grows nutrient-dense microalgae in proprietary closed bioreactors rather than open ponds to deliver clean, consistent spirulina for food and beverage manufacturers. The company originated from research into using microalgae to capture industrial CO2 from power-plant flue gas and has since focused on making spirulina a mainstream, sustainable food ingredient. Its product line includes Fresh Spirulina Paste, Fresh-Frozen Spirulina, and Freeze-Dried Spirulina Powder, used in beverages, egg substitutes, noodles, meat replacements, pastas, and snacks. EnerGaia is a portfolio company of 500 Global. It publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Iterum Therapeutics
providers.description: Iterum Therapeutics plc is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, focused on developing novel anti-infective medications to treat multi-drug resistant (MDR) bacterial infections. Its lead product, ORLYNVAH (sulopenem), is described as the first oral and IV penem antibiotic targeting gram-negative resistant infections. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Iterum Therapeutics is a pharmaceutical/biotech company and does not operate a public developer API; as of March 2026 the company entered liquidation following a High Court order in Ireland.

providers.name: Mission Barns
providers.description: Mission Barns is a Berkeley, California cultivated-meat company founded in 2018 that grows real animal fat from cells to make animal-friendly pork products — including meatballs, bacon, pepperoni, chorizo, and sausage — built on Mission Fat, its proprietary cultivated pork fat. It is the first company to receive both FDA and USDA clearance for cultivated fat and operates a dual B2C consumer-brand and B2B ingredient / co-development model across foodservice and CPG partners. This API Evangelist profile is a portfolio-company lead (backed by Point Nine); the company runs a consumer marketing site and publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Oncimmune
providers.description: Oncimmune is a biotechnology company specializing in antibody and autoantibody biomarker discovery for precision medicine. Its proprietary ImmunoINSIGHTS platform screens against 9,000+ human antigens using Luminex xMAP bead-based multiplexed immunoassay technology, minimal sample volumes, high-throughput automated robotic workflows, and proprietary machine-learning algorithms to identify immune-system signatures across immuno-oncology, autoimmune disease, and infectious disease. Products include the ImmunoINSIGHTS 2K targeted panels, custom biomarker discovery services, and bioinformatics/data-science multiomics integration. Oncimmune was acquired by Alden Scientific in July 2025. The company operates as a research and discovery services provider and does not publish a public developer or API platform.

providers.name: Taxa
providers.description: Taxa Technologies is a San Francisco and Tokyo synthetic-biology startup engineering the human skin microbiome. Its debut consumer product is a shelf-stable probiotic deodorant cream: a single application of Taxa Probiotics (25.4 billion CFUs in a base of water, mango butter, and sunflower extract) lasts one week by swapping out the skin microbes responsible for body odor, with a line focused on Wakiga (severe underarm odor). The company frames the skin microbiome as a platform whose microbes drive body odor, UV absorption, and mosquito attraction. Backed by Matrix Partners, Taxa currently runs a product waitlist and publishes a consumer marketing site with People, Science, Terms, and Privacy pages, but no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Vir
providers.description: Vir Biotechnology, Inc. (NASDAQ: VIR) is a clinical-stage immunology company headquartered in San Francisco that combines immunologic insights with modern technology platforms to treat and prevent serious infectious diseases and, increasingly, cancer. Its pipeline spans chronic hepatitis B and D, respiratory infections, and dual-masked T-cell engagers for solid tumors, built on antibody, T-cell, innate-immunity, and small interfering RNA (siRNA) platforms. Vir is a research and corporate organization surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal — only its corporate and investor websites.

providers.name: Alchemab Therapeutics
providers.description: Alchemab Therapeutics is a UK-based clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation antibody therapeutics for hard-to-treat diseases. Its "Adaptive Immunity" platform identifies naturally resilient individuals, such as long-term cancer survivors, and harnesses their protective antibodies, using artificial intelligence and deep learning to translate these natural immune responses into novel human-derived therapeutics across neurodegeneration, oncology, and other areas of high unmet need. Alchemab was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network. As a research-stage therapeutics company it publishes no public developer API program, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.

providers.name: Alexandria Real Estate Equities
providers.description: Alexandria Real Estate Equities is an urban office REIT and the leading owner, operator, and developer of life science, agtech, and technology campuses in AAA innovation cluster locations across the United States. The company partners with biotechnology, pharmaceutical, agtech, and technology firms to provide laboratory and office space, venture investments, and thought leadership. Alexandria Real Estate Equities does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: Centivax
providers.description: Centivax is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in South San Francisco, California, developing broad-spectrum vaccines to prevent infectious diseases at scale. Its lead program is a universal, broadly protective influenza vaccine in Phase 1 clinical development designed to protect against all strains of the virus. The company's pandemic-prevention work received a Gates Foundation Grand Challenge award and was featured in Netflix's "Pandemic: How to Prevent an Outbreak." Centivax's mission is to accelerate the world's transition to a post-pathogen humanity. This is a life-sciences company profile in the API Evangelist network; Centivax does not currently publish a public developer or API platform.

providers.name: Schrödinger
providers.description: Schrödinger is a New York-headquartered (NASDAQ: SDGR) computational science company that develops a physics-based and AI-driven molecular simulation platform used across drug discovery and materials science. Its flagship desktop modeling environment is Maestro (MS Maestro for materials science), which integrates a deep stack of computational tools — Glide (docking), FEP+ (free energy perturbation), Desmond (molecular dynamics), Jaguar (quantum chemistry), Prime (protein structure prediction), BioLuminate (biologics), LigPrep, QikProp, SiteMap, and WaterMap — together with the Schrödinger-maintained PyMOL visualization system. LiveDesign is the cloud-native enterprise design lab where chemists, biologists, and program teams collaborate on molecules, run computational workflows, and integrate experimental data; it exposes a snap-in API framework for connecting in-house and third-party tooling. The Schrödinger Python API (current release 2026-1) is the primary developer surface, providing programmatic access to molecular structures, Maestro automation, jobcontrol, Glide, FEP+, Desmond, Jaguar, MacroModel, Prime, BioLuminate, and LiveDesign integration (login, export, dataset and column management). Schrödinger also ships KNIME extensions, command-line drivers for every computational product, and maintains a meaningful open-source footprint on GitHub — including PyMOL, maeparser, coordgenlibs, sketcher, gpusimilarity, csmiles, and the fixed-data-table-2 React component. The business has two segments — software licensing to global pharma, biotech, and materials companies, and a co-developed and proprietary drug discovery pipeline. There is no public developer signup or self-serve REST API; access to the platform, Python API, and LiveDesign is gated through commercial licensing and the my.schrodinger.com customer portal.

providers.name: Celerion (H.I.G. Capital)
providers.description: Celerion is a global contract research organization (CRO) specializing in early-stage clinical research, Phase I clinical trials, clinical pharmacology, and bioanalytical services that accelerate drug development from first-in-human studies through proof-of-concept. Headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska with clinical and bioanalytical sites across North America and Europe, Celerion supports pharmaceutical and biotechnology sponsors with healthy-volunteer and special-population studies, bioanalysis, biomarker assays, ECG/cardiac safety, and its LabNotes bioanalytical data-management software. The company is a portfolio holding of H.I.G. Capital and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network via the bain-capital-ventures portfolio graph. As a corporate/marketing web presence with no public developer or API program, this profile carries only the artifacts that could be observed on the public web (llms.txt, domain-security posture).

providers.name: Evox Therapeutics
providers.description: Evox Therapeutics is an Oxford, United Kingdom based biotechnology company developing genetic medicines that expand the reach of gene therapy into the brain to transform the treatment landscape for severe neurodegenerative diseases. Its proprietary ExoEdit platform combines the natural transport capabilities of exosomes with CRISPR-based gene editing to improve the delivery, potency, and safety of genetic treatments for central nervous system disorders such as Rett Syndrome. Evox is a venture backed life-sciences company (investors include GV) and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes a corporate and scientific website but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Kyverna Therapeutics
providers.description: Kyverna Therapeutics (Nasdaq: KYTX) is a patient-centered, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Emeryville, California, developing engineered T cell therapies for patients suffering from autoimmune diseases. Kyverna adapts CD19 CAR T-cell therapy — originally developed for B cell cancers — to deeply deplete the B cells that drive autoimmunity, with the goal of durable, drug-free remission. Its lead candidate, mivocabtagene autoleucel (miv-cel, KYV-101), is a fully human CD19 CAR T-cell therapy in Phase 2 development for stiff person syndrome, myasthenia gravis and multiple sclerosis, and in Phase 1/2 development for systemic sclerosis and lupus nephritis in the United States and Germany. The pipeline also includes next-generation autologous and allogeneic CAR T constructs, including KYV-201, built on the company's Ingenui-T rapid manufacturing platform. Kyverna is a biopharmaceutical operating company and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile tracks its public web, corporate and investor surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Leyden Labs
providers.description: Leyden Labs is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Leiden, The Netherlands, with a regional office in Singapore, developing intranasal antibody products that protect people against known and newly emerging respiratory viruses. Its approach pairs mucosal immunity — delivering antibodies directly into the nasal passages, the gateway respiratory viruses use to enter the body — with broad protection, by targeting conserved regions of viral proteins so a single product can cover circulating strains and future variants. Its lead program, PanFlu, is an intranasal antibody candidate in clinical trials derived from CR9114, among the most broadly neutralizing influenza antibodies identified to date. Founded in 2021 by Koenraad Wiedhaup and Ronald Brus with founding scientist Jaap Goudsmit, the company is backed by GV and the SoftBank Vision Fund alongside the European Innovation Council Fund, the European Investment Bank and Invest-NL. Leyden Labs publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK; this profile captures its public web, security and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: LifeMine Therapeutics
providers.description: LifeMine Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Watertown, Massachusetts, with sites in Gloucester, Massachusetts and Basel, Switzerland. It pioneers a Top-Down Drug Discovery approach that leverages evolutionary insights from fungi to find next-generation precision medicines. Its LifeBank collection of deep-sequenced wild-type fungi and its Avatar-Rx platform combine human genetics and genomics, bioinformatics, machine learning and synthetic biology to mine biosynthetic gene clusters for genetically encoded small molecules, using embedded target genes as avatars to predict therapeutic effect independent of chemical structure. Its lead program LIFE-001 is a precision-engineered calcineurin inhibitor in Phase 1 for immune-mediated disorders and organ transplant rejection, alongside a genomic drug discovery alliance with GSK. LifeMine publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Treeline Biosciences
providers.description: Treeline Biosciences is a drug discovery and development company that aspires to make great medicines reliably and repeatedly, matching compelling disease targets with clinically proven drug approaches -- small-molecule inhibitors, protein degraders, and antibody drug conjugates -- enabled in-house at its U.S. and EU research facilities and integrated with in silico and machine learning models that help its scientists understand protein targets at an atomic level. The company pursues a target-centric preclinical pipeline serving patients with serious diseases across oncology, immunology, and neurology, and is a portfolio company of GV. Treeline publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Vivid Vision
providers.description: Vivid Vision is a digital vision care company that builds VR- and software-based tools for diagnosing and treating binocular vision disorders. Its products include a vision training system for amblyopia (lazy eye), strabismus, and convergence insufficiency; Vivid Vision Perimetry (VVP), a VR-based visual field test used as an endpoint in ophthalmology clinical trials for geographic atrophy, AMD, and glaucoma; and EYEBAB VT therapeutic exercises for clinical settings. Founded in 2014, the platform has been used by more than 100,000 patients across 50+ countries through eye-care practices and clinics. Vivid Vision is backed by Uncork Capital. The company is a patient- and clinician-facing vision-care provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface at this time.

providers.name: Turbine
providers.description: Turbine (Turbine Ltd) is a Budapest-based AI biotechnology company that virtualizes biological experiments to accelerate and de-risk drug discovery. Its Simulated Cell platform trains virtual cells on genomic, transcriptomic, and perturbation-response data, then runs millions of in silico experiments per day to predict therapy response across cell lines, patient-derived organoids and xenografts, and patient samples. Turbine offers partner-facing products for target discovery and de-risking, combination design, and ADC (antibody-drug conjugate) intelligence, and works with pharmaceutical partners including AstraZeneca and MSD. The company publishes research code and benchmarks on GitHub but exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Actio Biosciences
providers.description: Actio Biosciences is a San Diego-based clinical-stage biotechnology company developing precision medicines that translate insights from Mendelian (single-gene) genetics into treatments for both rare and common diseases. Its pipeline targets genetically defined conditions including KCNT1-related epilepsy and TRPV4-related Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2C (CMT2C), following a strategy of expanding from rare indications into more prevalent diseases that share the same underlying biology. The company is backed by Canaan Partners. Actio publishes no developer or API surface; this profile captures its public identity and corporate web properties.

providers.name: Alterome Therapeutics
providers.description: Alterome Therapeutics is a clinical-stage precision oncology company founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Diego, California, backed by Canaan Partners. The company designs alteration-specific cancer therapies using deep biology and chemistry expertise paired with an in-house computational chemistry platform ("The Kraken"), a custom CPU/GPU compute array for physics-based molecular simulation and drug design. Its clinical pipeline includes ALTA2618, a mutation-selective inhibitor for AKT1 E17K-driven cancers, and ALTA3263, an oral pan-KRAS ON-state inhibitor targeting more than 90% of KRAS mutations in cancer. Alterome was surfaced through the Canaan Partners portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Averna Therapeutics
providers.description: Averna Therapeutics is a genetic-medicine biotechnology company creating what it calls the last, great missing tool required to break through the most persistent barriers in genetic medicine. Backed by Insight Partners, the company was recognized as an Endpoints 11 Most Promising Biotech Company in 2025 and has presented at the 44th Annual J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference. As a therapeutics R&D company it does not currently publish any public developer program, API, SDK, or API documentation surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks it as a company identity record only.

providers.name: Basking Biosciences
providers.description: Basking Biosciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in Research Triangle, North Carolina (with operations in Mitchelton, Queensland, Australia) developing novel therapies for life-threatening blood clots. Its lead program BB-031 is an investigational RNA aptamer that targets von Willebrand Factor (vWF) to deliver a rapid-onset, targeted, and reversible thrombolytic for acute ischemic stroke, paired with BB-025, a direct-acting reversal agent designed to rapidly neutralize BB-031. The company is running the RAISE Phase 2 clinical trial and is backed by Insight Partners. Surfaced as a VC portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface, so this profile carries company identity only.

providers.name: Covance (Fortrea)
providers.description: Covance was a contract research organization (CRO) acquired by Labcorp in 2015 and rebranded as Labcorp Drug Development in 2021. In 2023, the clinical development business was spun off as Fortrea, an independent CRO headquartered in Durham, North Carolina, operating in 90+ countries and serving the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device industries with clinical trial management, central laboratory, and bioanalytical services. No public API or developer portal is currently published; integrations are arranged through sponsor and partner agreements.

providers.name: Gandeeva
providers.description: Gandeeva Therapeutics is a Vancouver, Canada-based precision-medicine and drug-discovery company that combines cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) with artificial intelligence and machine learning to visualize druggable transient protein-protein interactions at atomic resolution and design first-in-class molecular glues and engineered antibodies. Its structure-guided platform spans target prediction and validation (SPOTLIGHT), hit identification across virtual and fragment libraries (HYPERFOCUS), and cryo-EM-driven lead optimization (CRYO-CADD), with an oncology-focused pipeline of proximity-inducing small molecules. The company raised a $40M Series A and has run cryo-EM research collaborations with partners including Moderna and Zymeworks. Gandeeva is a private biotechnology company and does not publish a public developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company/portfolio record.

providers.name: Merida Biosciences
providers.description: Merida Biosciences is a Cambridge, Massachusetts biopharmaceutical company developing precision immunology therapies for autoimmune and allergic disorders. The company targets the pathogenic drivers of antibody-driven diseases with the goal of durable clinical responses while minimizing the side effects of current non-specific autoimmune treatments. Launched in 2025 with $121 million in funding and backed by GV, Merida operates as a preclinical therapeutics company with a science-and-pipeline website and no public developer, API, or technical product surface.

providers.name: Newleos Therapeutics
providers.description: Newleos Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company co-founded by Longwood Fund and seasoned CNS drug-development leaders, headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. Its pipeline, licensed from Roche, develops oral small-molecule therapeutics targeting GABAA-gamma1, V1a, TAAR1 and GABAA-alpha5 mechanisms, with first- or best-in-class potential for general anxiety, social anxiety, substance use disorders, and cognitive impairment. Newleos is a pharmaceutical R&D company with no public developer or API product surface; this profile captures its corporate web presence for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Alamar Biosciences
providers.description: Alamar Biosciences is a precision proteomics company advancing early disease detection through its NULISA platform and ARGO HT System. NULISA (NUcleic acid Linked Immuno-Sandwich Assay) combines a sequential immunocomplex capture-and-release mechanism with next-generation sequencing readout to deliver attomolar sensitivity and high-plex multiplexing for protein biomarker discovery, validation, and translational research. The fully automated ARGO HT System processes up to 288 samples per batch with under 30 minutes of hands-on time, supporting large-cohort studies across neurology, immunology, and oncology. Alamar was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network; it is a life-sciences instrument and assay provider rather than a public-API company, so this profile captures identity, published web surface, and domain-security posture. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface was found.

providers.name: Barinthus Biotherapeutics
providers.description: Barinthus Biotherapeutics plc (Nasdaq: BRNS) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel immunotherapies designed to guide and reprogram T cells to overcome autoimmunity, inflammatory disease, chronic viral infection, and cancer. Its lead SNAP-TI and SNAP-CI antigen-specific platforms and ChAdOx/MVA immunotherapeutic candidates power a five-program pipeline including VTP-1000 (celiac disease), VTP-300 (chronic hepatitis B), VTP-200 (high-risk HPV), VTP-850 (recurrent prostate cancer), and VTP-1100 (HPV-related cancer). The company was formed in 2021 through the merger of Oxford University spinout Vaccitech plc and NIH/Johns Hopkins spinout Avidea Technologies, and is headquartered in Germantown, Maryland with research facilities in the UK. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network. As a therapeutics company it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or agent surface.

providers.name: Elligo Health Research
providers.description: Elligo Health Research is a healthcare-enabling clinical research organization (CRO) that embeds clinical trials directly into real-world healthcare settings. Through its proprietary IntElligo Research Stack and System of Accelerated Research (SOAR) model, Elligo connects sponsors and CROs to known, diverse patient populations across 115+ hospitals and health systems, 200+ healthcare-based sites, and 100+ research-based sites. Services span site networks, patient access and recruitment, decentralized and hybrid trial solutions, site support and staffing, and concierge patient retention and travel logistics. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Elligo is tracked as a portfolio-lead in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Healx
providers.description: Healx is a Cambridge, UK clinical-stage biotechnology company that uses artificial intelligence to discover and develop new treatments for rare diseases. Its Healnet platform pairs generative AI with drug-discovery and rare-disease expertise to build a biomedical knowledge graph from public and proprietary sources - biomedical literature, disease and biochemical datasets, clinical trials and patents - and to identify novel uses for known compounds. Founded by David Brown and Tim Guilliams, Healx advances its own therapeutic pipeline (including its NF1 lead candidate HLX-1502) and partners with pharma companies such as Sanofi. Healx does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its identity and public web surface in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Pharmaron
providers.description: Pharmaron is a life-science contract research, development, and manufacturing organization (CRO/CDMO) providing R&D services across the full drug-discovery and development pipeline for the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry. Its services span laboratory research, chemistry, biology, drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics, safety assessment, chemistry-manufacturing-and-controls (CMC), and clinical development for small molecules, biologics, and cell and gene therapies. Pharmaron operates globally with facilities in China, the US, and the UK and is publicly listed. It is a B2B partner to drug developers and does not currently publish a public developer portal or API.

providers.name: Vedana Therapeutics
providers.description: Vedana Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation medicines for migraine prevention. Founded by biotech investor Anurag Agarwal and antibody-development veteran Leon Garcia, the company emerged from stealth in June 2026 with a $46 million Series A co-led by Westlake BioPartners and Canaan Partners, with participation from Dawn Biopharma and Alexandria Venture Investments. Vedana is building a portfolio of long-acting, subcutaneously dosed monoclonal antibodies that go beyond CGRP by targeting PACAP (pituitary adenylate cyclase-activating peptide) and other CGRP-independent pathways, aiming to deliver complete and lasting relief for the majority of migraine patients who remain suboptimally controlled on current standard of care. Its preclinical pipeline includes VDN-0100 (anti-PACAP antibody, first-in-human planned 2027), VDN-0200 (PACAP x CGRP bispecific), and two undisclosed programs. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Vedana is a therapeutics company and publishes no public API or developer surface; this record captures its corporate identity for discovery.

providers.name: VeriSIM Life
providers.description: VeriSIM Life is an AI-driven drug discovery and development company that applies mechanistic artificial intelligence and quantitative simulation to reduce the cost, time, and failure rate of translating drug candidates into clinical trials. Its BIOiSIM platform is a biosimulation decision engine that can screen large libraries of drug-like compounds and run simulation scenarios across species and dosing regimens, while AtlasGEN designs novel molecules and evaluates them for safety and efficacy. The company operates PulmoSIM Therapeutics as a subsidiary. VeriSIM Life exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; the platform is accessed through partnerships and demos. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for discovery and monitoring.

providers.name: Arcus Biosciences
providers.description: Arcus Biosciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing differentiated cancer immunotherapies, headquartered in Hayward, California. Its pipeline pairs multiple novel molecules across intra-tumoral immune pathways, including the HIF-2a inhibitor casdatifan, the CD73 inhibitor quemliclustat, the anti-TIGIT antibody domvanalimab, the anti-PD-1 antibody zimberelimab, and the CD39 inhibitor AB598. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network as a life-sciences company profile. Arcus publishes an agent-facing surface (llms.txt, an AI content map, and an Organization schema) but no public developer API.

providers.name: Link Cell Therapies
providers.description: Link Cell Therapies is a South San Francisco clinical-stage cell therapy company founded by Stanford investigators Robbie Majzner and Crystal Mackall in partnership with Samsara BioCapital, working on the development of safe and effective CAR T agents for patients with solid tumors. The company's logic-gate technology produces AND-gate CAR T cells that require co-expression of two cancer targets before driving cell cytotoxicity, giving greater tumor specificity than existing logic-gate approaches and aiming to avoid off-tumor toxicity. Alongside additional platforms under development, Link is advancing therapeutic programs across solid tumors and certain hematologic cancers, including a dual-targeting AND-gated CAR program (LNK001) directed at clear cell renal cell carcinoma, and in January 2026 entered a strategic collaboration with Johnson & Johnson to develop logic-gate LINK CAR T therapies. Link Cell Therapies publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface; this profile captures company identity and probed public-surface posture only.

providers.name: Empirico
providers.description: Empirico is a biotechnology company that powers therapeutic discovery with human genetics and small interfering RNA (siRNA) medicines. Combining internal capabilities in human genetics and siRNA chemistry with partner expertise, the company identifies naturally occurring genetic variations associated with health benefits and develops precision oligonucleotide therapeutics for common diseases with significant unmet medical need. In October 2024 Empirico entered a licensing agreement with GSK worth up to $745 million for a clinical-stage oligonucleotide targeting respiratory disease (COPD). Empirico is backed by DCVC. It is a pharmaceutical R&D company and does not operate a public technology or API platform.

providers.name: Radionetics Oncology
providers.description: Radionetics Oncology is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing precision radiopharmaceutical treatments for cancer. The company designs small-molecule radioligands that target G-protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) to selectively deliver targeted radiation therapy to solid tumors, including breast and lung cancer, combining GPCR biology expertise with medicinal chemistry. Radionetics entered a strategic agreement with Eli Lilly in 2024. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public developer, API, or technical-integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Atomic AI
providers.description: Atomic AI is a biotechnology company fusing machine learning with structural biology to unlock RNA drug discovery. Founded in 2017 by Raphael Townshend and based in San Francisco, the company builds ATOM-1, an AI foundation model that predicts the three-dimensional structure of RNA to enable the discovery and optimization of RNA-targeted small molecules and RNA-based medicines for previously undruggable targets, including certain cancers and neurodegenerative diseases. Atomic AI pairs its proprietary 3D RNA structure engine with large-scale in-house wet-lab assays. It is backed by Playground Global, 8VC, Greylock, and others. Atomic AI operates as a proprietary R&D drug-discovery platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity and web-surface signals for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: C. R. Bard
providers.description: C. R. Bard, Inc. was an American multinational developer, manufacturer, and marketer of medical technologies in the fields of vascular, urology, oncology, and surgical specialties. Bard was founded in 1907 by Charles Russell Bard and was acquired by Becton, Dickinson and Company (BD) in December 2017 for approximately $24 billion. Bard's product lines now operate as part of BD's Interventional segment under the BD Bard brand. No public API or developer portal is published; integrations with hospital and provider systems are arranged through BD enterprise channels.

providers.name: Create
providers.description: CREATE Medicines is a Cambridge, Massachusetts biopharmaceutical company developing in vivo CAR (chimeric antigen receptor) cell therapies using mRNA lipid-nanoparticle (mRNA-LNP) delivery. Its platform reprograms immune cells, including T cells, NK cells, and myeloid cells, directly inside the body rather than extracting and engineering them ex vivo, with clinical and preclinical programs spanning oncology, autoimmune disease, and fibrosis. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. The enrichment pipeline found no developer or API surface; this is a clinical-stage therapeutics company, not a software or platform provider, so no API artifacts were produced (none is the correct, non-fabricated result).

providers.name: Earli
