As a therapeutics developer, Halda operated no public developer platform, API, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company identity and portfolio-graph record rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Healthmode
providers.description: HealthMode was a machine-learning digital medicine company, founded in 2017 in San Francisco by Bradford Cross and Dan Karlin, that developed AI-enabled digital measurement methods to increase the precision and speed of clinical research. Its techniques improved phenotype understanding, streamlined screening and eligibility, enabled early detection of adverse events, and provided objective, low-burden efficacy endpoints for next-generation clinical trials. HealthMode was acquired by MindMed in 2021 and folded into MindMed's digital-medicine division (Albert); it no longer operates as an independent company, maintains no standalone website or public developer/API surface, and none of its former domains resolve.

providers.name: HilleVax
providers.description: HilleVax was a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing novel vaccines, most notably HIL-214, a virus-like-particle based vaccine candidate aimed at preventing moderate-to-severe acute gastroenteritis caused by norovirus infection. The company was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. Enrichment probing found no developer program, no API, no developer portal, and no public API documentation of any kind, which is expected for a clinical-stage vaccine developer rather than a technology/API producer. The company's primary domain (hillevax.com) now redirects to xoma.com (XOMA Royalty), indicating HilleVax has been acquired and wound down as an independent operating company; XOMA Royalty itself was subsequently acquired by Ligand (closed July 2026). This profile is retained as a company/identity record with no API surface.

providers.name: i-Incubator Healthcare
providers.description: i-Incubator Healthcare is a pharmaceutical innovation incubator established by IDG Capital and officially launched in Shanghai (Xuhui District) in 2024. It operates an "incubation + empowerment" model to develop innovative drug-research programs across oncology, immunology, and metabolic disease areas, pairing global innovation perspectives with China-based execution to advance projects to international quality standards. It is backed by a dedicated, long-horizon (15-year) incubation fund. Surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital; this is a research/biotech venture with no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: IDEC Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: IDEC Pharmaceuticals is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of kleiner-perkins and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: immune-path
providers.description: Immune-Path (Yidao Biotechnology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. / 怡道生物) is a China-based vaccine biotechnology company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Suzhou. The company develops human vaccines across recombinant protein antigen, novel viral vector, and messenger RNA (mRNA) platforms, backed by its own vaccine adjuvant technology. Its clinical and preclinical pipeline includes a recombinant zoster (shingles) vaccine produced in CHO cells, a nine-valent recombinant HPV vaccine expressed in Pichia pastoris, a respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccine, a therapeutic gastric cancer vaccine, and a COVID-19 vaccine. Immune-Path is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It is a life-sciences drug developer with no public developer, API, or software surface; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Immunicon
providers.description: Immunicon Corporation (NASDAQ IMMC) was a Huntingdon Valley, Pennsylvania biotechnology company that pioneered immunomagnetic cell-selection technology for isolating and characterizing rare circulating tumor cells (CTCs) from blood. It developed the CellSearch and CellTracks diagnostic platforms, licensed to Veridex, LLC (a Johnson & Johnson company) for oncology use. Immunicon filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2008 and was acquired by Veridex/Johnson & Johnson; the CellSearch platform later passed to Menarini Silicon Biosystems. The company was backed by Canaan Partners and publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: Informatics
providers.description: Informatics encompasses the science of information and computation, including bioinformatics, health informatics, clinical informatics, and computational biology. This index is a topic-level placeholder for cataloging APIs and services across informatics tools, data management, and analytical capabilities for research and healthcare applications.

providers.name: Jungla
providers.description: Jungla, Inc. was a San Francisco precision-medicine informatics startup founded in 2016 by Alexander Colavin and Carlos Araya. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and IndieBio, it built a cloud-based Functional Modeling Platform (FMP), also described as a Molecular Evidence Platform, that combined functional genomics, computational biophysics, cellular engineering, and machine learning to produce auditable predictive models for clinical genetic and genomic variant interpretation. Jungla emerged from stealth in 2018 and was acquired by Invitae Corporation in July 2019 (approximately $59M), where its technology augmented Invitae's Sherloc variant-classification approach. The company is now defunct; its original developer surface (jungla.io) is offline and no public API, documentation, or SDKs survive. This profile is a historical record surfaced from the a16z portfolio; it carries no live developer artifacts.

providers.name: Kelun-Biotech
providers.description: Sichuan Kelun-Biotech Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (Kelun Botai, HKEX: 6990), a Chengdu-based subsidiary of Sichuan Kelun Pharmaceutical (SZSE: 002422) established in 2016, is an innovative biopharmaceutical company focused on the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of novel drugs. It specializes in antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) and other conjugated therapies across both large-molecule and small-molecule modalities, targeting oncology and autoimmune diseases. The company operates several core drug-discovery platforms and maintains a pipeline of 30+ candidates with multiple approved and clinical-stage programs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network; as a pharmaceutical manufacturer it publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Legit Patents
providers.description: Legit (listed by Seedcamp as "Legit Patents", 2016 cohort, legit.ai) was a Cambridge, Massachusetts startup applying natural-language processing to scientific and patent literature, which it developed into an on-demand expert network for the life sciences. Its product let pharmaceutical, biotech and medical-device teams search a corpus the company described as more than two million experts backed by roughly forty million data points, then pay a flat fee per reply to message key opinion leaders directly instead of scheduling calls — marketed for R&D, business development and licensing (BD&L), strategic alliances and integration management. The company is no longer operating: substantive legit.ai content disappears from the web archive after 2021, its LinkedIn company page returns HTTP 404, and the legit.ai domain is now parked on GoDaddy/Afternic and listed for sale (Afternic nameservers, a null MX record and an SPF "-all" policy). No public API, developer portal, documentation or machine-readable specification was ever published; see review.yml for the full probe record.

providers.name: LongBio Pharma
providers.description: LongBio Pharma (Suzhou/Shanghai, founded 2020) is a Chinese clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the in-house discovery and development of innovative antibody and fusion-protein therapeutics for allergic, autoimmune, and complement-mediated diseases. Its lead programs include the anti-IgE antibody LP-003 for chronic spontaneous urticaria and asthma. Co-founded by Dr. Bill Nai-chau Sun (co-founder of Tanox and co-inventor of Omalizumab/Xolair), LongBio raised a Series B2 round led by Qiming Venture Partners and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (01779.HK) in June 2026. It is a pharmaceutical drug developer with no public developer or API surface; this profile was surfaced as a Qiming portfolio company and completed an enrichment pass.

providers.name: Manas AI
providers.description: Manas AI is an artificial-intelligence drug-discovery company co-founded by Reid Hoffman and physician-scientist Siddhartha Mukherjee, launched in late 2024 and backed by General Catalyst and Greylock. The company applies machine learning and computational biology to accelerate the discovery and design of new medicines, with an initial focus on hard-to-treat cancers such as breast and prostate cancer and lymphoma. Manas AI operates as a private biotech / therapeutics research organization rather than a developer-facing platform: as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation. This entry is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile surfaced from the General Catalyst portfolio.

providers.name: Matrix Pharmaceutical
providers.description: Matrix Pharmaceutical is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: MBX Biosciences
providers.description: MBX Biosciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel precision peptide therapies for endocrine and metabolic disorders, built on its proprietary PEPs platform. Lead programs include canvuparatide (MBX 2109) for hypoparathyroidism, plus MBX 4291, MBX 5765, and MBX 6XXX. Surfaced as a portfolio company of NEA and added to the API Evangelist network; no public API surface was found at this time.

providers.name: Medikine
providers.description: Medikine is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in San Diego, California, engineering a new class of medicines called PEPTIKINES — synthetic peptide mimetics of cytokines and growth-factor receptor agonists. PEPTIKINES emulate the beneficial activities of natural cytokines while being much smaller in molecular weight and structurally unrelated in sequence, making them amenable to enhanced pharmacokinetics, cell targeting, and conditional activation without generating neutralizing antibodies to native cytokines. The company's lead candidate, MDK-703, is an Fc-fusion protein containing an IL-7 PEPTIKINE that mimics the T-cell-supporting properties of IL-7, with a pipeline spanning oncology, autoimmune, and infectious-disease therapeutics. Medikine is a private, venture-backed drug-discovery company and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or technical developer surface.

providers.name: Mendra
providers.description: Mendra is an AI-native biopharma company focused on developing breakthrough medicines for rare and ultra-rare pediatric diseases. It partners with R&D-stage biotech companies to accelerate clinical development and commercialization, handling regulatory, clinical, and reimbursement strategy while prioritizing the needs of patients and families. Founded by a team with experience from BioMarin, Palantir, and other pharma and biotech companies, Mendra launched with an $82 million Series A round and is backed by 8VC and Wing Venture Capital. The company operates a corporate marketing website and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Millennium Pharma
providers.description: Millennium Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company founded in 1993 in Cambridge, Massachusetts, that pioneered a genomics-based, platform approach to drug discovery and development. Backed early on by Mayfield, the company built its reputation on large research and development alliances with major pharmaceutical partners and on discovering and commercializing medicines for cancer and other diseases. Millennium was acquired by Takeda Pharmaceutical Company in 2008 and now operates as the Takeda Oncology unit. It is a therapeutics and drug-discovery organization, not an API or developer-platform provider, and exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Millennium Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Millennium Pharmaceuticals was a biopharmaceutical company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, focused on oncology and inflammation, best known for developing the cancer drug Velcade (bortezomib). Backed early by Kleiner Perkins, it was acquired by Takeda Pharmaceutical Company in 2008 for $8.8B and its brand was retired to "Takeda Oncology" in 2013; it no longer operates as an independent company. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio stub. This is a research/company profile with no independent developer API surface — the pipeline confirmed the provider publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or event/webhook surface.

providers.name: Minghui Pharmaceutical
providers.description: Minghui Pharmaceutical is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Minova Pharma
providers.description: Nanjing Minova Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd. (南京迈诺威医药科技有限公司) is a drug-discovery and pharmaceutical R&D company founded in February 2021 and headquartered in Nanjing, China. The company focuses on the discovery, development, and industrialization of novel drugs for mental diseases and disfiguring (cosmetic/dermatological) diseases, operating in the consumer-pharmaceutical space as both a drug R&D house and supplier. Its stated capabilities span early drug discovery, compound/drug screening, and druggability (developability) research. Surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Minova Pharma publishes a corporate marketing website but exposes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Molecular Assemblies
providers.description: Molecular Assemblies is a synthetic biology company that developed a Fully Enzymatic Synthesis (FES) platform for de novo DNA production, using enzymatic chemistry to synthesize longer (up to ~400 base), higher-purity oligonucleotides faster than traditional phosphoramidite methods, targeting next-generation sequencing, gene synthesis, diagnostics, and therapeutics markets. Originally a DCVC-backed startup, the company's assets and intellectual property were acquired by Maravai LifeSciences, and its enzymatic DNA synthesis technology is now part of TriLink BioTechnologies. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface; its former molecularassemblies.com domain now redirects to TriLink BioTechnologies.

providers.name: Molecular Stethoscope
providers.description: Molecular Stethoscope (now operating as Superfluid Dx, Inc.) is a South San Francisco clinical-stage diagnostics company developing minimally invasive blood tests for neurodegenerative disease. Its cell-free messenger RNA (cf-mRNA) liquid-biopsy platform aims to detect Alzheimer's disease at early stages from a routine blood draw, as an alternative to spinal taps and brain imaging. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcvc and added to the API Evangelist network. As a clinical diagnostics R&D company it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or technical platform; this profile is maintained for network completeness rather than API discovery.

providers.name: MycoMedica
providers.description: MycoMedica Life Sciences, PBC is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded by mycologist Paul Stamets and backed by Obvious Ventures, True Ventures, and Kittyhawk Ventures. The company develops fungi-derived therapeutic drugs, including its lead psilocybin candidate MLS101 and the "Stamets Stack" (a novel blend of niacin, psilocybin, and lion's mane), for the prevention and treatment of psychiatric and neurological disorders. It raised $60 million in Series A funding in 2022 and is advancing pre-clinical and clinical research toward FDA approval. MycoMedica is a life-sciences drug-development company and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Mynvax
providers.description: Mynvax is a clinical-stage vaccine biotechnology company based in Bengaluru, India, developing recombinant, thermostable vaccines for respiratory viral infections. Spun out of the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), the company applies protein-stabilization and structure-based antigen design to create thermotolerant COVID-19 and influenza vaccine candidates aimed at affordable distribution in low- and lower-middle-income countries without deep cold-chain requirements. Mynvax is a life-sciences research company and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation portal, or technical integration surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and is maintained in the API Evangelist network for discovery.

providers.name: Neumora
providers.description: Neumora Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering a new era of precision medicines to restore brain health and wellbeing. It develops therapeutics for brain diseases and neuropsychiatric conditions, applying a precision-medicine approach to neuroscience drug discovery and development. Neumora was surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. As a therapeutics company it maintains a corporate and investor web presence but exposes no public developer API, SDK, CLI, or documentation surface: probing its domain for /.well-known/ discovery documents, an OpenAPI/Swagger spec, an llms.txt, and developer/docs paths returned no machine-readable API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Nextcure
providers.description: NextCure, Inc. (NASDAQ NXTC) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering and developing novel immunomedicines to treat cancer and other immune-related diseases. The company uses its FIND-IO platform to identify and characterize immunomodulatory targets and biological pathways, advancing a pipeline of immunotherapy drug candidates. NextCure surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of canaan-partners. Enrichment probe (2026-07-20) found no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal; this is a biopharmaceutical R&D organization with no programmatic API surface to catalog.

providers.name: novamab
providers.description: Novamab (洛启生物) is a Shanghai-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company specializing in VHH (nanobody) antibody drug development for respiratory and inflammatory diseases such as asthma, COPD, and IBD. Its platforms span inhaled antibodies, oral antibodies, and dual/multi-specific antibodies alongside integrated drug formulation and manufacturing. Surfaced as a portfolio company of qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment confirmed the company publishes a corporate website but no developer API, documentation portal, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Novome
providers.description: Novome Biotechnologies is a DCVC-backed biotechnology company based in South San Francisco developing genetically engineered microbial medicines (GEMMs) - live bacterial therapeutics designed to colonize the gut and treat chronic conditions such as enteric hyperoxaluria and other GI and metabolic diseases. As a therapeutics developer, Novome is a research-and-drug-development organization rather than a software or API provider; the enrichment pass found no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Omniome
providers.description: Omniome was a San Diego genomics company that developed Sequencing By Binding (SBB) technology, a proprietary chemistry aimed at highly accurate short-read DNA sequencing. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcvc, Omniome was acquired by Pacific Biosciences (PacBio) in 2021, and its site now redirects to pacb.com. It builds laboratory sequencing instruments and chemistry rather than a public developer platform, and exposes no public API surface.

providers.name: Orbital Therapeutics
providers.description: Orbital Therapeutics was a Cambridge, Massachusetts biotechnology company developing next-generation RNA medicines, combining circular and linear RNA, targeted delivery, and AI-guided design across immunomodulation, in vivo CAR-T cell therapy, next-generation vaccines, and protein therapeutics. Its lead program, OTX-201, targeted autoimmune disease through B-cell depletion. Founded out of Beam Therapeutics and backed by ARCH Venture Partners, a16z Bio + Health, and Newpath Partners, the company raised a $270M Series A in 2023. In October 2025 Bristol Myers Squibb agreed to acquire Orbital Therapeutics for $1.5 billion; orbitaltx.com now redirects to bms.com. As a therapeutics developer, Orbital publishes no public developer platform, API, or machine-readable API surface, so this record is an identity-only profile in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: oricell
providers.description: Oricell Therapeutics (原启生物) is a Shanghai-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell-based immunotherapies for cancer, including GPC3-targeted CAR-T (Ori-C101) for advanced liver cancer and GPRC5D-targeted CAR-T (OriCAR-017) for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. It operates proprietary OriAb antibody-discovery, OriCAR T-cell persistence, and cell-manufacturing (CMC) platforms. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners. As a clinical-stage biotech it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or technical developer surface; this profile is retained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: OvaScience
providers.description: OvaScience was a Waltham, Massachusetts biotechnology company founded in 2011 (by Michelle Dipp, Richard Aldrich, Christoph Westphal, Jonathan Tilly, and David Sinclair) that developed fertility and assisted-reproduction treatments for female infertility. Its two marquee IVF services were Augment (autologous mitochondrial transfer into a patient's egg) and OvaTure (maturing egg-precursor stem cells into eggs), launched in clinics in the UAE, Canada, and Japan starting in 2014. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. OvaScience is defunct: in August 2018 it merged with Millendo Therapeutics via a reverse merger. It publishes no developer API, no OpenAPI, and no developer/documentation surface; its former domain (ovascience.com) now resolves to a parked lander.

providers.name: Overt
providers.description: OverT Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation, programmed off-the-shelf (allogeneic) cell therapies and biologics for solid tumors. The company pairs AI-powered genome-scale genetic discovery with tumor-targeting receptor engineering and naturally tumor-homing gamma delta T cells, plus scalable manufacturing intended to reduce treatment time and cost. Its pipeline includes OVT-101, a CLDN6-targeted CAR-T for ovarian cancer (first-in-human anticipated H1 2027), and OVT-201, a non-MHC T cell engager for solid tumors. Based in New York City and backed by Wing Venture Capital. As a therapeutics company, OverT Bio publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: Pallando Therapeutics
providers.description: Pallando Therapeutics is an early-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation targeted protein degraders with an emphasis on precision targeting, under the tagline "Intelligent Degradation, Innovative Therapies." It was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this profile its public website (pallandotx.com) is a coming-soon placeholder and it publishes no developer API, documentation, SDKs, or other technical surface for the enrichment pipeline to harvest.

providers.name: Pardes Bio
providers.description: Pardes Biosciences was a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing novel therapeutics to treat and prevent viral diseases. Founded in 2020 and based in Carlsbad, California, it used structure-based drug design and a tunable, reversible covalent chemistry platform. Its lead candidate, PBI-0451, was an oral direct-acting antiviral for SARS-CoV-2. The company was acquired in 2023 and no longer operates independently. It has no public API, developer program, or technical integration surface, and its former domain (pardesbio.com) is now a parked/registrar page.

providers.name: Pathios Therapeutics
providers.description: Pathios Therapeutics is a clinical-stage oncology and immunology drug discovery and development company based in Oxfordshire, United Kingdom, founded in 2017. The company develops small-molecule inhibitors of the pH-sensing G protein-coupled receptor GPR65 to counteract the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment; its lead asset PTT-4256 is a first-in-class GPR65 inhibitor now in a Phase 1/2 clinical trial. Backed by Canaan, Brandon Capital, and a strategic investment from Bristol Myers Squibb, Pathios is a research-stage biotech with no public API, developer platform, or technical integration surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and processed by the enrichment pipeline, which confirmed there is no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Peninsula Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Peninsula Pharmaceuticals is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Pozen
providers.description: POZEN Inc. was a specialty pharmaceutical company headquartered in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, founded in 1996 and focused on developing therapeutics for pain and pain-related conditions, most notably acute migraine. It was best known for the products Treximet (sumatriptan/naproxen) and Vimovo (naproxen/esomeprazole). POZEN traded publicly on NASDAQ under the ticker POZN and in 2016 combined with Tribute Pharmaceuticals to form Aralez Pharmaceuticals. Pozen was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As a pharmaceutical company it operated no public developer program, API, or SDK surface; an enrichment pass confirmed no API artifacts exist to harvest.

providers.name: RhyGaze
providers.description: RhyGaze is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing gene therapy treatments to restore vision for people with retinal degenerative diseases. Its platform combines optogenetic proteins that engineer photosensitivity into mammalian cells with gene therapy delivery tools that install light-sensing machinery into human eye cells, technology originating at the Institute of Molecular and Clinical Ophthalmology Basel (IOB) in Switzerland. The team includes executives who helped develop and commercialize Luxturna, the first FDA-approved gene therapy for a genetic disease. RhyGaze operates from Basel, Switzerland and Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and is backed by GV. As a therapeutics company it publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Ricerca Biosciences
providers.description: Ricerca Biosciences is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Semnur Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Semnur Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing non-opioid pain-management therapies. Its lead program, SP-102 (SEMDEXA), is a novel, non-opioid, preservative-free and particulate-free injectable corticosteroid gel formulation intended to treat moderate-to-severe chronic radicular pain (sciatica). Semnur is a subsidiary of Scilex Holding Company and is headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, California. As a pharmaceutical R&D company it publishes a corporate website, investor presentation, and scientific publications, but exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Silicon Therapeutics
providers.description: Silicon Therapeutics was a Boston-based biotechnology company that built an integrated, physics-based drug-discovery platform combining quantum mechanics, molecular simulation, and machine learning to design small-molecule medicines against historically intractable targets. Founded in 2015, it was acquired by Roivant Sciences in 2021 to form the basis of Roivant's computational discovery engine; its former site (silicontx.com) now redirects to roivant.com. The company is a computational drug-discovery firm with no public API, developer platform, SDK, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Sirtris Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Sirtris Pharmaceuticals is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: biotech. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Sunshine Lake Pharma
providers.description: Sunshine Lake Pharma (Guangdong East Sunshine Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., also known as HEC Pharm) is a Chinese pharmaceutical company established in 2003 and part of the Dongyangguang (HEC) Group. It engages in drug research, development, production, and commercialization across innovative drugs, improved formulations, generics, and biosimilars, focused on infections, chronic diseases, and oncology. Notable products include oseltamivir phosphate (influenza), sofosbuvir-based hepatitis C therapy, and insulin glargine (diabetes). It is a manufacturer with no public developer or API surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Syntax Bio
providers.description: Syntax Bio is a synthetic biology company programming the next generation of cell therapies. Its proprietary Cellgorithm platform uses a CRISPR-based system to program and accelerate stem cell differentiation, replacing slow, labor-intensive processes with a rapid, programmable approach that mimics human development to generate diverse functional cell types at scale. The company is advancing pancreatic beta cell therapy for type 1 diabetes and is backed by DCVC Bio, Astellas Venture Management, Illumina Ventures, and others. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of dcvc; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, SDK, or programmatic developer surface as of this pass.

providers.name: Teligene
providers.description: Teligene (Suzhou Teligene Biotechnology Co., Ltd.) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2011 in Suzhou, China by Dr. Zhang Dawei, a former chief scientist at Amgen. The company focuses on the design, research and industrialization of innovative small-molecule targeted drugs for oncology, with a pipeline addressing lung cancer, breast cancer, and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Teligene US LLC is a wholly owned US subsidiary advancing these candidates through clinical development. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as a drug-development biotech it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Teneobio
providers.description: Teneobio was a privately held, clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a new class of biologics, Human Heavy-Chain Antibodies (UniAb), for the treatment of cancer, autoimmunity, and infectious diseases. Its TeneoSeek discovery platform combined genetically engineered animals (UniRat, OmniFlic), next-generation sequencing, bioinformatics, and high-throughput vector assembly. Teneobio was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. Amgen acquired Teneobio in October 2021 for $900 million upfront plus up to $1.6 billion in contingent milestone payments; the company no longer operates independently and publishes no live developer surface. This is a life-sciences / therapeutics company with no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: ThirtyFiveBio
providers.description: ThirtyFiveBio is an Oxford, UK biotechnology company founded in 2021 to develop first-in-class small-molecule inhibitors of G protein-coupled receptor 35 (GPR35) for the treatment of gastrointestinal diseases, including ulcerative colitis, inflammatory bowel disease, and digestive-tract cancers. The company was incubated by the M:M Bio (Molecule to Medicine) drug-discovery ecosystem together with Canaan Partners, and is backed by AbbVie Ventures, Mayewell Capital, and Innovate UK. It is a preclinical drug-discovery company with plans for first-in-human trials, not a software or API provider; this profile carries no developer API surface.

providers.name: Thrive Earlier Detection
providers.description: Thrive Earlier Detection Corp. was a healthcare/biotech company commercializing CancerSEEK, a machine-learning-driven liquid biopsy blood test to detect multiple cancer types from a single blood draw. Spun out of Johns Hopkins technology and backed by Lux Capital, Bain Capital Life Sciences, Casdin, Google Ventures and others, it raised large early rounds before being acquired by Exact Sciences in 2020/2021 for roughly $2.15 billion and folded into Exact Sciences. This profile was surfaced as a Lux Capital portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. It is a clinical-diagnostics company with no public developer API surface; its former web presence (thrivedetect.com) is decommissioned.

providers.name: Tizona Therapeutics
providers.description: Tizona Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing first-in-class cancer immunotherapies by translating novel scientific insights into new medicines. Its lead program, TTX-080, is a first-in-class HLA-G antagonist in clinical trials for advanced solid tumors. Tizona is a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. As a pharmaceutical drug-development company it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface; this profile is retained as a network company record rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Tobira Therapeutics
providers.description: Tobira Therapeutics is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Tome Bioscience
providers.description: Tome Biosciences is a genome-editing therapeutics company founded in 2021 and based in Watertown, Massachusetts. It develops programmable genomic integration (PGI) technology that pairs the site-specificity of CRISPR/Cas with integrase enzymes to insert genetic sequences of virtually any size into the genome without relying on double-strand DNA breaks. The company was cofounded by Omar Abudayyeh and Jonathan Gootenberg, formerly of MIT's McGovern Institute, and raised roughly $213M across Series A and B financing led in part by a16z. Its stated programs target integrative gene therapies for monogenic liver diseases and cell therapies for autoimmune conditions. Tome is a biopharmaceutical R&D company with no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface; its documented website (tome.bio) does not currently resolve. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company / enrichment lead rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Topography
providers.description: Topography (Topography Health, Inc.) was a full-stack clinical trials platform that empowered community and private-practice physicians to run clinical drug trials in their local communities across North America, reducing the administrative burden of becoming a clinical trialist. Founded in 2020 by Alexander Saint-Amand, Mac Parish, and Andrew Kirchner and based in New York and Los Angeles, the company launched in January 2022 with $27.5M in funding, including a $21.5M Series A led by Bain Capital Ventures and Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). In 2026 Topography Health's Site Business Unit was acquired by FOMAT Medical Research, and the company's public site is now a single-page acquisition announcement. Topography was a B2B clinical-research SaaS, not a developer-facing API company: no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface was ever published, and none exists today.

providers.name: Trillium Therapeutics
providers.description: Trillium Therapeutics was a Toronto-based clinical-stage immuno-oncology biopharmaceutical company developing cancer therapeutics (notably CD47-targeting agents). It was acquired by Pfizer in August 2021 for approximately $2.2B and no longer operates as an independent entity. Surfaced as an nea portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a life-sciences lead. Enrichment found no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or developer-portal surface; the company website no longer serves content.

providers.name: Unnatural Products
providers.description: Unnatural Products (UNP) is a Santa Cruz, California biotechnology company founded in 2017 by UC Santa Cruz alumni Cameron Pye and Joshua Schwochert. The company operates a drug-discovery platform for synthetic macrocyclic peptides, combining data science, machine learning, and parallel chemical synthesis to rapidly optimize potency, selectivity, and passive membrane permeability against traditionally "undruggable" targets that sit between small molecules and biologics. UNP works primarily through pharmaceutical research collaborations, including partnerships with Novartis, Merck, Argenx, and BridgeBio, and has raised approximately $38.4M. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Wing Venture Capital, it exposes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Verastem
providers.description: Verastem Oncology (Verastem, Inc.) is a development-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel therapies for cancers driven by the RAS/MAPK pathway, including KRAS-mutant tumors. Its work includes the first FDA-approved treatment for KRAS-mutant recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer, plus a pipeline targeting KRAS G12D inhibition. As a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and enriched with verified identity only.

providers.name: Verge Genomics
providers.description: Verge Genomics (now operating as Verge Labs) is an AI-driven drug discovery biotechnology company using human genomics data and machine learning to discover and develop treatments for neurodegenerative and neuromuscular diseases such as ALS and Parkinson's. Its proprietary all-in-human CONVERGE platform integrates large-scale multi-omic patient datasets derived from human tissue with machine learning to identify novel therapeutic targets, and has been applied in pharmaceutical collaborations with Eli Lilly, AstraZeneca and Alexion. As of enrichment, the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API specification; CONVERGE is an internal research platform, not a consumer-facing API.

providers.name: Vima Therapeutics
providers.description: Vima Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel oral therapies for movement disorders, with a focus on the underlying biology of dystonia and Parkinson's disease. Its lead program is an experimental oral therapy being evaluated in the Stride dystonia clinical study, aimed at helping patients regain control of movement rather than only managing symptoms. The company targets dystonia, dystonic cerebral palsy, and Parkinson's disease — conditions that collectively affect more than one million people in the United States. Vima was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. As a patient- and clinician-facing therapeutics company, it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, or technical documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Vincentage
providers.description: Vincentage (Vincentage Pharma Co., Ltd.) is a clinical-stage biotech founded in 2021 and headquartered in Suzhou, China, developing novel small-molecule drugs for metabolic and cardiometabolic diseases including type 2 diabetes, obesity, and MASH. Its lead candidate is VCT220 (also known as CX11), an oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist; worldwide rights (excluding Greater China) to CX11 were acquired by Corxel Pharmaceuticals. Investors include IDG Capital, Everest VC, Shenzhen Capital Group, Galaxy Industry Group, and Kunshan Asia Aroma. Surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as a drug-discovery pharmaceutical company it publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical artifacts.

providers.name: Vium
providers.description: Vium was a preclinical biotechnology company that operated a "digital vivarium" — a cloud-connected laboratory platform that continuously monitored laboratory animals with sensors and computer vision to generate high-resolution physiological and behavioral data for pharmaceutical drug discovery and toxicology studies. Backed by DCVC and Lux Capital, Vium was acquired by Recursion Pharmaceuticals in 2021 and no longer operates as an independent company. Its former primary domain (vium.com) is now parked and listed for sale, and it publishes no live developer portal, documentation, or API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Vivace Therapeutics
providers.description: Vivace Therapeutics is a clinical-stage, oncology-focused biotechnology company based in the San Francisco Bay Area, developing small-molecule cancer therapeutics that target the Hippo-YAP signaling pathway. Its lead candidate, VT3989, is in clinical trials for mesothelioma and other solid tumors. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a private therapeutics developer, Vivace publishes clinical-trial, scientific-publication, and corporate content, but exposes no public developer portal, API, SDK, documentation, or code repositories.

providers.name: Wecare Probiotics
providers.description: Wecare Probiotics (微康益生菌) is a Chinese biotechnology company specializing in probiotic strain research, intelligent manufacturing, and application solutions for the food, nutrition, and agriculture industries. It operates three research institutes and five intelligent manufacturing facilities across Suzhou, Luohe, and Wuhan, producing product lines including WecLac probiotics, WecPro formula, and WecCul. Its BLa80 strain became the first probiotic strain approved for infant food in mainland China. The company presents a corporate information website only; no public developer portal, API, or technical documentation is published, so this profile carries company identity rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Zhuhai DL Biotech (medicaldl)
providers.description: Zhuhai DL Biotech Co., Ltd. (Zhuhai Deer Bioengineering Co., Ltd., brand "DL" / 迪尔), founded in 2003 and based in Zhuhai, China, is a high-tech in-vitro diagnostics (IVD) enterprise specializing in the R&D, manufacturing, and service of microbial diagnostic instruments and reagents. Its product lines cover automated blood culture systems, automated bacterial identification and antimicrobial susceptibility testing (ID/AST), MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry microbial identification, automated staining, fluorescence immunoassay, and molecular diagnostics, serving over 5,000 clinical healthcare institutions across more than 50 countries. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. Enrichment pass found no public API, developer portal, SDK, or software integration surface — this is a diagnostic-hardware and reagent business, not a software/API provider.

providers.name: Plexium
providers.description: Plexium is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of crv, dcvc, lux-capital, softbank-vision-fund and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: biotech. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Tasca Therapeutics
providers.description: Tasca Therapeutics is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: biotech. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Micrographia Bio
providers.description: Micrographia Bio is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of dcvc and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

bands.label: Not Yet Rated
bands.blurb: Providers we have not scored yet — unknown, not zero.

providers.name: Alzheon
providers.description: Alzheon, Inc. is a privately held clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2013 and headquartered at 111 Speen Street, Framingham, Massachusetts, developing oral small-molecule therapeutics and diagnostics for Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative disorders. Its lead candidate, valiltramiprosate (ALZ-801) — a valine-conjugated prodrug of tramiprosate that blocks the formation of neurotoxic soluble beta-amyloid oligomers — has FDA Fast Track designation and completed the pivotal APOLLOE4 Phase 3 trial in APOE4/4 homozygotes with early Alzheimer's disease. Alzheon operates no product or developer API and publishes no developer portal, SDKs or API documentation; its corporate site does serve the standard WordPress REST API anonymously, which makes its press releases, science pages and media library machine-readable.

providers.name: Arbor Biotechnologies
providers.description: Arbor Biotechnologies is a next-generation gene editing company founded in 2016 by Feng Zhang, David Walt, David Scott and Winston Yan, and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Its proprietary AI- and machine-learning-guided discovery engine has produced a toolbox of programmable DNA editors spanning knockdown, nuclease excision and compact reverse-transcriptase editing, aimed at functionally curative genomic medicines. The wholly-owned pipeline is focused on liver disease (ABO-101 for primary hyperoxaluria type 1 and ABO-103, both LNP-delivered and partnered with Chiesi Group) and CNS disease (ABO-202, ABO-203 and ABO-204 for ALS, plus ABO-206, all AAV-delivered), alongside collaborative ex vivo cell therapy programs run with Vertex, Allogene, Edigene and Chiesi. Investors include ARCH Venture Partners, Ally Bridge Group, Temasek, TCG and the Samsung Life Science Fund. Arbor operates no product or developer API and publishes no developer portal, SDKs or API documentation; its corporate site does serve the standard WordPress REST API anonymously, which makes its press releases, site pages and taxonomies machine-readable.

providers.name: Ashvattha Therapeutics
providers.description: Ashvattha Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a new class of precision nanomedicines built on hydroxyl dendrimer therapeutics (HDTs), a platform exclusively licensed from Johns Hopkins University. Hydroxyl dendrimers traverse tissue barriers such as the blood-retinal and blood-brain barrier and are selectively taken up by activated cells in regions of inflammation, allowing known small-molecule drugs to be delivered intracellularly to diseased tissue with sustained effect and reduced off-target exposure. The company is advancing programs across ophthalmology, neurology, and inflammatory disease, led by migaldendranib (MGB), a first-in-class subcutaneously administered nanomedicine in Phase 2 development for diabetic macular edema and neovascular age-related macular degeneration, plus hydroxyl dendrimer PET imaging tracers such as [18F]OP-801. Founded by Jeffrey L. Cleland, Kannan Rangaramanujam, and Sujatha Kannan. Ashvattha publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Brightseed
providers.description: Brightseed is a bioactives and AI company founded in 2017 (San Francisco, CA, with operations in Durham, NC) that uses its Forager AI platform to map the compounds in plants to human biological pathways and health benefits. Forager draws on a proprietary dataset the company describes as the world's largest — 21 million bioactive compounds and hundreds of biological receptors spanning 23 health areas — combining high-resolution omics, high-throughput robotics and machine learning to predict which natural compounds confer a benefit and where to source them at commercial scale. Hummingbird, launched in 2026, layers an agentic AI system on top of Forager to carry partners from discovery through development. Brightseed sells discovery services (Bioactive Profiler, Bioactive Ingredient Finder) and market-ready ingredients (Bio Gut Fiber, Bio Meta Control, Bio Gut Core) to food, supplement and health-science companies. Brightseed publishes no product or developer API for Forager or Hummingbird — those are sold as enterprise engagements through a contact form. The single machine-readable surface the company operates is the WordPress REST API (wp/v2) behind its corporate site at www.brightseedbio.com, which exposes anonymous read access to posts, pages, categories, tags, users, media, comments, search, taxonomies, types and statuses, plus authenticated write operations via WordPress application passwords. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from that live surface.

providers.name: Canaan Partners
providers.description: Canaan Partners is an early-stage venture capital firm founded in 1987 as a management buyout spin-out from General Electric's venture unit. The firm invests in "visionaries with transformative ideas," backing companies from seed through Series A across a roughly 60/40 split between technology and healthcare. On the technology side Canaan funds developer tools, security, infrastructure, fintech, consumer, AI, and frontier/deep-tech companies; on the healthcare side it specializes in de novo biotech creation, therapeutics, and medical devices. Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut with offices in San Francisco, Menlo Park, and New York City, Canaan has raised roughly $7 billion across 13 funds and is actively deploying Fund XIII. Over its 37-year history the firm reports a track record of 73 IPOs and 152 M&A exits, with notable investments including Instacart, LendingClub, The RealReal, DexCom, Match.com, Snyk, Turo, Cardlytics, and Day One Biopharmaceuticals.

providers.name: CRV
providers.description: CRV (formerly Charles River Ventures) is one of the oldest venture capital firms in the United States, founded in 1970 to commercialize research coming out of MIT. The firm invests early — primarily at the Seed and Series A stages, with occasional Series B — leading rounds in enterprise, consumer, developer tools, security, data infrastructure, AI, and bioengineering companies. CRV has backed more than 750 companies since inception across 18 funds, raising over $4.3 billion (including a recent $600M early-stage fund), and has seen 80-plus of its portfolio companies reach public-company status. Notable investments include DoorDash, Airtable, HubSpot, Datadog, Zendesk, Patreon, Mercury, Vercel, Cursor, Postman, Kong, Tailscale, Ring, and PillPack. The firm is headquartered in San Francisco (52 Zoe Street) with a long-standing Bay Area presence and offices in Menlo Park, CA and Cambridge, MA.

providers.name: Formation Bio
providers.description: Formation Bio (formerly TrialSpark, rebranded in December 2023) is a New York-based, tech-driven, AI-native pharmaceutical company co-founded by Ben Liu and Linhao Zhang. Rather than discovering molecules, Formation Bio in-licenses and acquires clinical-stage drug assets and runs them through a proprietary, software- and AI-driven development engine that compresses clinical planning, trial execution and regulatory work. That engine is a suite of internal platforms — Delphi (probability-of-technical-success and value modeling), Atlas (clinical-stage asset screening), Forge (autonomous trial design and scenario evaluation), Apollo (trial execution, study startup, enrollment and closeout), ARK (an AI orchestration layer connecting 80+ internal systems behind one governed interface) and a unified Data Platform spanning trial data, real-world patient data, literature and standardized ontologies. The company raised a $372M Series D led by Andreessen Horowitz with participation from Sanofi, and built Muse, an AI patient-recruitment system, with Sanofi and OpenAI. Formation Bio's technology is internal-facing: as of this profile the company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API contract, or client SDKs.

providers.name: Lux Capital
providers.description: Lux Capital is a New York City-based venture capital firm founded in 2000 by Josh Wolfe, Peter Hebert, and Robert Paull that backs entrepreneurs building companies at the frontier of science and technology, turning "sci-fi into sci-fact." The firm systematically mines academia and government research labs for breakthrough technologies that have matured beyond proof-of-concept but have not yet attracted mainstream venture attention, then makes long-term bets on contrarians and outsiders challenging the status quo. Lux invests primarily at early stage across three focus areas: AI and technology, defense/space/ manufacturing, and biotech/healthcare, with an emphasis on deep tech, robotics, and emerging science. The firm manages roughly $7 billion in assets under management across nine core funds, closing Lux Ventures IX at $1.5 billion in January 2026, and has invested in over 200 companies. Through Lux Labs, launched in 2024, the firm has also helped create more than 20 new companies. Notable portfolio companies include Anduril, Applied Intuition, Databricks, Cognition, Ramp, Runway, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Planet, and Saildrone. Lux is headquartered in New York City with an additional office in Silicon Valley.

providers.name: Qiming Venture Partners
providers.description: Qiming Venture Partners is a leading China-based venture capital firm founded in 2006 by Duane Kuang and Gary Rieschel, headquartered in Shanghai with additional offices in Beijing, Suzhou, Hong Kong, Singapore, and a U.S. affiliate (Qiming Venture Partners USA) in Seattle, Washington. The firm invests at the early and growth stages, with roughly 70% of its investments concentrated in Series A and Series B rounds, across two core practice areas: Technology (mobile internet, consumer, AI, robotics, semiconductors, enterprise software, autonomous driving) and Healthcare (biotech, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, diagnostics, and digital health). Qiming manages 11 U.S. Dollar funds and 7 RMB funds with approximately $9.5 billion in capital raised, and has backed more than 580 companies, of which over 210 have exited via IPO on the NYSE, NASDAQ, HKEX, Shanghai, or Shenzhen exchanges, or through M&A. It is an early backer of some of China's most influential technology companies, including Xiaomi, Meituan, Bilibili, Zhihu, Roborock, Hesai Technology, UBTech, WeRide, Insta360, and Zhipu AI (Z.ai), alongside a deep healthcare portfolio spanning Zai Lab, Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals, CanSino Biologics, Tigermed, and Insilico Medicine.
